note: prêteur : Amazon.com Services, LLC, filiale d'Amazon.com, Inc. (le préambule rattache le prêt à l'accord de fusion du 20 juillet 2022) ; corps à lire en passe C (D-0036)
quote: THIS INTERIM LOAN AND GUARANTY AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") dated as of November 14, 2022 (the "Effective Date") between AMAZON.COM SERVICES, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Lender"), and 1LIFE HEALTHCARE, INC., a Delaware corporation ("Borrower"), provides the terms on which Lender shall lend to Borrower and Borrower shall repay Lender.

note: « Lender » désigne Amazon.com Services, LLC et « Borrower » 1Life Healthcare, Inc. dans le préambule ; prêt à tirage différé, plafond de 300 M$
quote: Lender has agreed to make available to Borrower a senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facility (the "DDTL Facility") in an aggregate principal amount of up to $300,000,000 (the "Maximum DDTL Amount").
